design: Laurentii-inspired rosette with nine upright swords, irregular broken green chevrons, uneven golden margins, olive-rim ceramic and amber inlay eyes.
visualReview: Reviewed front, side and rear Blender renders. All nine exported leaves carry vertex pigment. Owner approval pending.
provenance: Original Blender geometry, pottery, vertex pigments and authored keyframes. Botanical references informed the silhouette and color pattern.
